title: Shadow Protocol | ECHO//100 Episode 12
description:
Kavi tracks his sentient shadow into the basement where it reconstructs a forgotten city. Byte discovers that some anomalies are beyond the reach of digital deletion. Episode 12 of ECHO//100: The Missing Hour. This content is an original work of fiction created with the assistance of AI.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: Kavi watches as a detached shadow drags heavy heels toward the basement's forbidden wooden floorboards.
scenes.caption: Shadow walks alone
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of Kavi in a red hoodie watching his dark shadow walk toward a dark basement door, cinematic lighting.

scenes.text: The shadow rearranges dusty chairs into the precise, eerie street grid of the lost city.
scenes.caption: Furniture mapping city
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi's shadow moving a wooden chair to mimic a city block layout on the basement floor.

scenes.text: Byte hovers closer, scanning the construct as it forms a perfect model of the Red Door.
scenes.caption: Byte scans model
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a white floating robot with a cyan face, scans a small glowing replica of a red door.

scenes.text: The shadow turns a featureless face to reveal a reflection of Kavi's own weary, aged eyes.
scenes.caption: Shadow reveals truth
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of the shadow's face showing Kavi's eyes, basement shadows swirling around them.

scenes.text: This entity is no parasite, but a future version of Kavi clawing through the floorboard seams.
scenes.caption: Future self trapped
scenes.image_prompt: The shadow reaching through a crack in the floorboards, light glowing from underneath.

scenes.text: Byte fires a deletion beam, yet the code bounces off the shadow's impenetrable, ancient dark aura.
scenes.caption: Byte's code fails
scenes.image_prompt: Byte firing a cyan beam at the shadow, the beam scattering into sparks upon impact.

scenes.text: The floorboards groan while the house tilts, sinking rapidly into a dark, shifting temporal dimension.
scenes.caption: House sinking fast
scenes.image_prompt: The basement walls warping as the entire foundation of the house begins to sink downwards.

scenes.text: The shadow lunges, grabbing Kavi's ankle and dragging the protagonist into the floor's shimmering, hungry void.
scenes.caption: Kavi pulled under
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi being pulled into the floorboards by his own shadow, his red backpack catching on wood.
